0030_steam_catalog_abstract_world.sql:
-- A game with no fictional setting still needs an explicit world classification
-- before it can be marked ready (e.g. abstract puzzle or board games).
INSERT INTO steam_catalog_terms (facet, slug, label)
VALUES ('world', 'abstract-no-setting', 'Abstract / No Setting')
ON CONFLICT (facet, slug) DO NOTHING;
0031_steam_catalog_pagination_indexes.sq:
-- Stable ordering and fast status-filtered catalog pages / classification queue.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS steam_catalog_games_name_id_idx
  ON steam_catalog_games (name, id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS steam_catalog_games_status_name_id_idx
  ON steam_catalog_games (status, name, id);

-- Substring ILIKE searches may later benefit from pg_trgm (optional extension).
-- Do not require that extension on hosted databases for this migration.
0032_steam_catalog_classification_revisi:
-- Optimistic concurrency token for human-authored classification only.
-- Steam re-import changes metadata but must not invalidate an editor's draft.
ALTER TABLE steam_catalog_games
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS classification_revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;

-- Default upgrades existing records without changing their existing taxonomy.
-- Atomic UPDATE ... WHERE id = ? AND classification_revision = ? prevents
-- lost updates from two different editors using the same base revision.
0033_steam_catalog_trigram_search.sql:
-- Optional acceleration of substring search on Steam metadata.
-- pg_trgm is a trusted extension in supported PostgreSQL releases, but
-- managed providers may restrict CREATE EXTENSION. Never break deployment
-- when an administrator has not enabled it.
DO $catalog_search$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'pg_trgm') THEN
    BEGIN
      CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;
    EXCEPTION
      WHEN insufficient_privilege OR undefined_file OR feature_not_supported THEN
        RAISE NOTICE 'Steam catalog: pg_trgm unavailable; using existing search without trigram indexes';
    END;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_opclass AS c
    JOIN pg_am AS m ON m.oid = c.opcmethod
    WHERE c.opcname = 'gin_trgm_ops' AND m.amname = 'gin'
  ) THEN
    -- Resolve the extension's operator class schema explicitly; managed DBs
    -- may install pg_trgm into public rather than the current search_path.
    EXECUTE format(
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS steam_catalog_games_name_trgm_idx ON steam_catalog_games USING gin (name %I.gin_trgm_ops)',
      (SELECT n.nspname FROM pg_opclass c
       JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.opcnamespace
       JOIN pg_am m ON m.oid = c.opcmethod
       WHERE c.opcname = 'gin_trgm_ops' AND m.amname = 'gin' LIMIT 1)
    );
    EXECUTE format(
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS steam_catalog_games_developer_trgm_idx ON steam_catalog_games USING gin (developer %I.gin_trgm_ops)',
      (SELECT n.nspname FROM pg_opclass c
       JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.opcnamespace
       JOIN pg_am m ON m.oid = c.opcmethod
       WHERE c.opcname = 'gin_trgm_ops' AND m.amname = 'gin' LIMIT 1)
    );
    EXECUTE format(
      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS steam_catalog_games_publisher_trgm_idx ON steam_catalog_games USING gin (publisher %I.gin_trgm_ops)',
      (SELECT n.nspname FROM pg_opclass c
       JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.opcnamespace
       JOIN pg_am m ON m.oid = c.opcmethod
       WHERE c.opcname = 'gin_trgm_ops' AND m.amname = 'gin' LIMIT 1)
    );
  END IF;
END
$catalog_search$;
0035_steam_catalog_import_jobs.sql:
-- Persistent server-side Steam growth jobs (one resumable active job).
-- Workers claim short leases atomically; a restart can safely reclaim expired
-- work without duplicating games thanks to steam_catalog_games.steam_app_id.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS steam_catalog_import_jobs (
  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running'
    CHECK (status IN ('running', 'paused', 'completed')),
  steam_cursor integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (steam_cursor >= 0),
  pending jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(pending) = 'array'),
  has_more boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  max_games integer NOT NULL CHECK (max_games BETWEEN 1 AND 20000),
  processed integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (processed >= 0),
  inserted integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (inserted >= 0),
  existing integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (existing >= 0),
  ignored integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (ignored >= 0),
  failed integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (failed >= 0),
  scanned integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (scanned >= 0),
  pause_requested boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  lease_token uuid,
  lease_expires_at timestamptz,
  next_run_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_error text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  finished_at timestamptz,
  CHECK (processed <= max_games),
  CHECK (inserted + existing + ignored + failed <= processed)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS steam_catalog_import_jobs_single_active_idx
  ON steam_catalog_import_jobs ((true))
  WHERE status IN ('running', 'paused');

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS steam_catalog_import_jobs_due_idx
  ON steam_catalog_import_jobs (next_run_at, id)
  WHERE status = 'running';

COMMENT ON TABLE steam_catalog_import_jobs IS
  'Resumable, lease-guarded Steam game discovery/import tasks. No API keys stored.';
0038_steam_catalog_global_source_throttl:
-- Cross-replica SteamSpy polling guard. One atomic reservation per upstream
-- "request=all" GET, shared between HTTP discovery and background workers.
-- Do not reserve slots for cached pages or for Steam Store detail checks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS steam_catalog_source_poll_limiter (
  source text PRIMARY KEY,
  next_allowed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT '-infinity'::timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT steam_catalog_source_poll_limiter_source_check
    CHECK (source = 'steamspy_all')
);

COMMENT ON TABLE steam_catalog_source_poll_limiter IS
  'Atomic cross-replica 65s SteamSpy all-pages request limiter (not a game import cursor).';
